title: WrestleMania XV
summary: This document is about WrestleMania XV, the 15th annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE), held on March 28, 1999, at the First Union Center in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The document begins with an overview of the event, noting its ten scheduled matches, ticket sales of 20,276, and main attractions, including "Stone Cold" Steve Austin challenging The Rock for the WWF Championship in a no disqualification match and The Undertaker facing Big Boss Man in a Hell in a Cell match. The "Production" section covers the background of WrestleMania as the WWF's flagship event and details the numerous storylines leading into the show, such as the Hardcore Championship feud involving Road Dogg, Al Snow, and Hardcore Holly; the Brawl for All matchup between Bart Gunn and boxer Butterbean; the WWF Championship saga between The Rock, Mankind, and Mr. McMahon; the rivalries surrounding Ken Shamrock, Val Venis, Ryan Shamrock, and Goldust; the Triple H–Kane–Chyna conflict; the X-Pac versus Shane McMahon European Championship feud; the Sable–Tori Women's Championship storyline; The Undertaker's Ministry of Darkness angle; and the extended Austin–McMahon rivalry culminating in the Royal Rumble and a steel cage match. The "Event" section describes the pre-show Rage Party and Sunday Night Heat matches, followed by detailed accounts of the preliminary matches, including the Hardcore Championship triple threat, the Tag Team Championship bout, Butterbean's 34-second knockout of Bart Gunn, the referee-determining match between Mankind and Big Show, the four-corners Intercontinental Championship match, Kane versus Triple H, the Women's Championship match, and Shane McMahon versus X-Pac. It then covers the main event matches: the controversial Hell in a Cell match where The Undertaker defeated Big Boss Man (including the notorious hanging aftermath), and the main event where Steve Austin defeated The Rock to win the WWF Championship. The "Reception" section presents mixed critical reviews and star ratings from outlets like Canadian Online Explorer, 411Mania, and Bleacher Report. Finally, the "Aftermath" section describes subsequent storylines, including Austin's continued feud with The Corporation and rematch with The Rock at Backlash, the Ministry of Darkness war, Bart Gunn's departure from the WWF, the formation of the X-Pac and Kane tag team, and Philadelphia's later hosting of WrestleMania XL in 2024.
